preconditions.description: The number of routers n is between 2 and 200000 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n-1 integers representing parent connections.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p < i for i, p in enumerate(p_list, start=2))
preconditions.description: For each router i from 2 to n, its parent p_i satisfies 1 <= p_i < i.

postconditions.description: The output path starts with router 1 and ends with router n.
All elements in the path are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(path[i+1] == p_list[path[i] - 2] if path[i] != n else False for i in range(len(path) - 1))
postconditions.description: For every consecutive pair in the path (except the last element), the next element is the parent of the current element as defined by the input array.

postconditions.expression: len(path) == sum(1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if i in path)
postconditions.description: The path contains exactly the nodes on the unique simple path from 1 to n in the tree structure defined by the parent array.
